title: Upmarket Modern. Luxury rooftop house in the Gulch
description:
A modern, comfortable  city house . Located  on the most walkable street! A short walk away from the Gulch and Midtown restaurants, shops and bars. 5 minute Uber to Broadway.

The space
This unique, industrial-chic home boasts Carrara marble waterfall counters throughout, heated concrete floors and a 20 foot ceiling. The living room and kitchen meet as one in this beautiful open concept home, conducive to comfortable get togethers. The living room has a big screen Samsung 4K TV and the house is updated with Nest thermostats throughout. This prime real estate is a 5-10 minute walk from all the greatest attractions of Nashville.
